twilight.	The	last	green	had	almost	faded	out	of	the	grass,
when	they	came	at	length	to	an	open	glade	not	far	above
the	banks	of	the	stream.
“Hmmm!	 it	 smells	 like	 elves!”	 thought	 Bilbo,	 and	 he
looked	up	at	the	stars.	They	were	burning	bright	and	blue.
Just	then	there	came	a	burst	of	song	like	laughter	in	the
trees:
O!	What	are	you	doing,
And	where	are	you	going?
Your	ponies	need	shoeing!
The	river	is	flowing!
				O!	tra-la-la-lally
								here	down	in	the	valley!
O!	What	are	you	seeking,
And	where	are	you	making?
The	faggots	are	reeking,
The	bannocks	are	baking!
				O!	tril-lil-lil-lolly
								the	valley	is	jolly,
												ha!	ha!
O!	Where	are	you	going
With	beards	all	a-wagging?
No	knowing,	no	knowing
What	brings	Mister	Baggins
				And	Balin	and	Dwalin
								down	into	the	valley
												in	June
																ha!	ha!
O!	Will	you	be	staying,
Or	will	you	be	flying?
Your	ponies	are	straying!
